result.summary: Found 3 issues related to missing content, text truncation, and generic visual assets.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is missing its restaurant name and metadata.
issues.suggestion: Ensure data bindings for card headers and labels are correctly populating.

issues.description: Text truncation occurs on the 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant label.
issues.suggestion: Expand the text container or enable multi-line wrapping for long names.

issues.description: Widespread use of generic 2D illustrations instead of actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder-style graphics with high-quality restaurant-specific images.
